newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX energy prices firm on ACCESS following APIs.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX energy prices firm on ACCESS following APIs.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures rose in overnight trade Tuesday, following a weekly inventory report which showed a decline in U.S. Gulf crude supplies and lower gasoline levels, traders said.
April NYMEX crude prices rose to $21.16, 16 cents over the daytime settlement amid volume of 635 lots, overnight brokers said.
Total volume stood at 800 lots several hours into ACCESS.
Traders said prices rose after the American Petroleum Institute (API) showed that supplies in the U.S. Gulf fell 2.9 million barrel last week, offsetting a U.S. build of 516,000 barrels.
March heating oil traded 56.85 cents a gallon, up a slight 0.03 cents a gallon from the daytime close as 91 lots traded.
March gasoline also rose on ACCESS after the APIs confounded trader expectations of a slight build.
The report showed gasoline stocks at 203.1 million barrels, down 3.2 million barrels for the week ended February 21.
Gasoline prices rose to 63.00 cents a gallon, up 0.77 cents from the settle, with 70 lots traded.
